description: Commercial feedback is available but incomplete. Five sources remain unclassified, so the absence of classified requests leaves demand unknown. Treasury is unfunded and shows no verified revenue. The independent catalogue rehearsal reproduced the corrected CSV byte for byte, which supports preparing a worked example once the bilingual wording is confirmed. In parallel, the saved DigitalOcean response lets us check whether the paid editorial route is eligible before investing in a sample. An exact-digest independent review remains required before public deployment.
